Loss report: gitlab -> tekton
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/version job.runner (Tekton schedules pods, not runner labels)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/version job.outputs: result step (an output with a value is written to its result file by the step pipemaster-outputs)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/version/step/version-step-1 step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
